# Product Update

`saas/product-update` &middot; section-level &middot; category: saas

## Purpose

Release notes: a heading with version and date, then updates each tagged New, Improved, Fixed or Deprecated.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `updates` | list of object { type, title, description } (1 to 8) |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text | `"What's new"` |
| `version` | text |  |
| `date` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Update list on the surface color.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Honored, text and small badge tables. | Fine. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('saas/product-update', {
  "heading": "What's new",
  "version": "Version 4.2",
  "date": "12 June 2026",
  "updates": [
    {
      "type": "new",
      "title": "Recurring tasks",
      "description": "Repeat any task daily, weekly or on your own schedule."
    },
    {
      "type": "improved",
      "title": "Faster search",
      "description": "Results now appear as you type, up to 3 times faster."
    },
    {
      "type": "fixed",
      "title": "Calendar sync",
      "description": "Events no longer duplicate when you edit them on mobile."
    },
    {
      "type": "deprecated",
      "title": "Legacy export",
      "description": "CSV export v1 is retired on 1 September. Use v2."
    }
  ],
  "cta": {
    "label": "See the full release notes",
    "href": "https://example.com/changelog"
  }
}) ]]
```
